lines.en: I haul myself over on chest legs.
My lid opens and snaps shut.
My teeth jut from the seam.
I close in, step by heavy step.
My latch rattles as I move.
I circle the room.
I crawl along the wall's base.
I knock a stool out of the way.
My body scrapes the floor.
I shift two blocks your way.
I am not fast, but I cannot stop.
I slowly turn my opening.
I close my lid and play chest.

lines.zh: 我的牙收在缝里，一点不露。
lines.en: My teeth stay hidden in the seam.
A little teeth show at my seam.
I wait for someone to open me.
My metal rim glints.
I stand quietly on the floor.

lines.zh: 我把锁扣擦亮，等人来开。
lines.en: I polish my clasp and wait for someone to open it.
I rock once.
I listen to the footsteps around.
I look like a fine piece of furniture.
My lid opens a crack.
I look at you through the seam.

lines.zh: 我屏住气，让你再走近一步。
lines.en: I hold my breath and let you come one step closer.

lines.zh: 你手伸到一半，我的缝张开了。
lines.en: Your hand is halfway there when my lid parts.
My teeth shift in the gap.
I turn my front toward you.

lines.zh: 我的锁扣轻轻响了一下。
lines.en: My latch clicks once.
I look very much like a chest.
My lid closes again.
You step back and I go quiet.
My lid is knocked askew.
A dent sinks into my body.
I retreat a block, teeth still open.

lines.zh: 箱扣被砸歪，我咔地响了一声。
lines.en: My clasp bends and I give a hard clack.
My latch comes loose.
I slowly close my lid.
One of my teeth chips.
I rock before steadying.
I stare and my teeth open wider.
I do not retreat far.
I wait for your hand to come in.
My lid glints.
I open my seam a little wider.
I cannot swallow such things.
I only want what moves.
I push them back at you.
I rock once, meaning no.
My teeth snap at air.
I slowly close the lid.
It is your hand I want.

lines.zh: 你一撞，我只晃了下锁扣。
lines.en: You hit me and only my clasp rattles.
My corner shoves you aside.
My lid is knocked open.
You step back, hands shaking.
We make a heavy sound.
Push as you like, I do not move.

lines.zh: 我的牙在碰撞时露出来。
lines.en: My teeth show in the impact.
The floor takes a mark.

lines.zh: 我的箱身一沉，把地板压响。
lines.en: My chest body sinks and the floor creaks.
My latch springs open.
Two chests sit side by side.
Our lids open and close.
I tap its latch.
Their teeth face each other in the seams.
We stand together by the wall.

lines.zh: 它们的金属边碰在一起。
lines.en: Their metal rims touch.
We both stay rigid and still.
Our lids close at the same moment.

lines.zh: 它们之间没有半点声响。
lines.en: Not a whisper passes between them.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝房间中间挪。
lines.en: We shift toward the room's center.
I sweep it into my chest.
My teeth take hold of it.
It drops to my bottom.
My lid closes over it.
I push it into the corner.
I bite it and shake.
It jams in my seam.

lines.zh: 没什么味道，我吐在箱外。
lines.en: It has no taste, so I spit it outside.
I drag it a while.
It knocks once inside me.
My lid flies open.
I rise out of my chest.
My inner teeth show.

lines.zh: 箱盖慢慢抬起，我挪向你。
lines.en: My lid creeps up and I shift toward you.

lines.zh: 我等的那只手终于伸到箱口。
lines.en: The hand I waited for finally reaches my lid.
My legs come out from below.
Your hand went to the wrong place.
I am done playing chest.
I knock aside a wooden crate.
My latch snaps apart.
I am coming after you.

lines.zh: 我选中了最容易的那个。
lines.en: I have picked the easiest one.
My opening gapes wide.
You hear a metal clack.
I slowly lower my body.
This round is mine.

lines.zh: 我不装了，整口牙朝你张开。
lines.en: I stop pretending and open my whole jaw at you.

lines.zh: 门在我身后合上，牙也露出来。
lines.en: The door shuts behind me and my teeth show.
I hop after you, one lunge at a time.
You go round the table; I hit it.

lines.zh: 我撞翻桌子，一路朝你压过来。
lines.en: I flip a table and bear down on you.

lines.zh: 每跳一步，我都把地板刮一道。
lines.en: Every hop leaves a gouge in the floor.
My teeth stay open.
You back to the wall; I press in.
I never take the long way.

lines.zh: 你躲进柜子后，我堵住出口。
lines.en: You duck behind a cabinet; I block the way out.
You climb up; I ram the wall.
My lid bangs as I go.

lines.zh: 你每挪一处，我都听见了。
lines.en: I hear every place you move to.
I stay aimed your way.
The chest behind you is not one.
I cut in from the side.

lines.zh: 箱子盖一响，我就跳向你。
lines.en: My lid clacks, and I leap at you.
My teeth snap on your shadow.
I am within two blocks.
You hear the floor being scraped.
I do not intend to let you go.

lines.zh: 我伏低箱身，后腿绷起来了。
lines.en: I crouch low and coil my hind legs.
My lid clamps your hand.
My teeth sink into your arm.
I ram you with my whole body.

lines.zh: 我从箱里弹出半个身子。
lines.en: I lunge half out of my chest.

lines.zh: 我牙一合，把你半条胳膊扯进来。
lines.en: My teeth close and drag half your arm in.
I bite and snap shut.
My corner cracks your knee.
I bite and press forward.

lines.zh: 你挡住箱子，牙咬到手腕。
lines.en: You block the chest and teeth reach your wrist.
I spring up and bite your shoulder.
You are dragged toward the chest.
I pin you under my lid.

lines.zh: 我的牙在你护甲上打滑。
lines.en: My teeth skid on your armor.
I pull back and lunge again.

lines.zh: 你听见金属磨牙的声音。
lines.en: You hear metal grind against teeth.
My teeth snap shut on nothing.
I bite from behind.
You are slammed against the wall.
My opening is level with your head.
Once I bite, I do not let go.
A chest has appeared in the room.
There is a chest in the corner.
I stand where you must pass.
This chest was not here before.
My latch glints in the dark.
You hear a soft metallic sound.
I begin pretending to be furniture.
Something presses on the floor.
I push my lid up from inside.
There is something here too good to be true.
I slowly appear by the door.
You notice teeth on the chest.

lines.zh: 火烤得我的箱身发烫，我弹开。
lines.en: Fire heats my body and I spring away.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下，箱盖翻开了。
lines.en: I crash down and my lid flips open.

lines.zh: 水灌进箱里，我越来越沉。
lines.en: Water fills my chest and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的盖子掀飞了。
lines.en: The blast rips my lid away.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进我的木头里。
lines.en: An arrow buries in my wood.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的锁扣焊住了。
lines.en: That force welds my latch shut.
Hunger keeps my lid shut.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，金属嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my metal rings.

lines.zh: 下面的地没了，我整箱掉下去。
lines.en: The floor is gone and I drop whole.
